items.title: 15.3.2 Be-rang maddon ke liye locating agents (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.3.2, printed pages 330-331.

blocks.text: Kaghaz sookhne ke baad us par jo pattern (naqsha) banta hai use chromatogram kehte hain. Agar mixture ke components rangeen hon to aankh se pehchane ja sakte hain. Agar be-rang (colourless) hon to chromatogram ko chemical ya physical tareeqon se develop karna parta hai taake spots nazar aayen.

Be-rang chromatogram dekhne ka bohat aasan tareeqa yeh hai ke use UV lamp ki roshni mein dekha jaye. UV roshni mein spots rangeen nazar aate hain. Doosra tareeqa yeh hai ke ninhydrin jaisa locating agent istemal kiya jaye jo spots ki jagah dikha deta hai.

blocks.title: Locating agent
blocks.text: Locating agent aam taur par aisa chemical hai jo amino acids jaise be-rang maddon se react kar ke rangeen products banata hai, jo dekhe ja sakte hain.

blocks.caption: Be-rang spots kaise dekhein
rows: spots ultraviolet roshni mein rangeen nazar aate hain
be-rang maddon (amino acids) se react kar ke rangeen products banata hai

blocks.prompt: Chromatogram ko develop karne ka kya matlab hai, aur locating agent kis liye istemal hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Develop karne ka matlab hai sookhe kaghaz par be-rang spots ko nazar aane ke qabil banana: UV roshni mein dekh kar, ya locating agent chhirak kar. Ninhydrin jaisa locating agent amino acids jaise be-rang components se react kar ke rangeen products banata hai jo un ki jagah dikha dete hain.

items: Chromatogram = sookhe kaghaz par spots ka pattern.
Be-rang spots UV lamp mein, ya ninhydrin jaise locating agent se dikhte hain (amino acids ke saath rangeen products).
